messages:
Mina: Heads-up: p95 for /summarize-text jumped on the canary after the kernel-selector v3 rollout — baseline ~120ms -> 210ms. Tail worse on 4k seqs. KV hit-rate down ~6%. Attaching logs and flamegraphs.

Ash: Which change specifically? the fused-attn-v2 path?

Mina: Yeah, we enabled fused-attn-v2 for long-sequence execution on H100 canary nodes.

Raj: Did batch formation change too? If average microbatch size fell, p95 could spike even if throughput improves.

Mina: Canary queue snapshot shows avg batch size dropped ~22% vs control. Lots of 1-2 item batches.

Sophia: What's token_budget for that route in canary? Summarize usually emits ~700-900 tokens — if token_budget=256 we'll flush early.

Mina: Canary used default token_budget=256. Also prefetch window was set to 128 in the new selector.

Ash: A lower prefetch window + new kernel ordering could cause more prefix rebuilds -> KV churn.

Mina: Eviction thresholds are unchanged. Prefetch ordering seems likely.

Raj: Queue sampler excerpt:
```
{"route":"summarize-text","batch_sizes":[1,1,2,3,1,1,4,2,1],"avg_batch":1.9,"seq_lengths":[900,1200,450,800,300]}
```

perfbot: alert: p95 breach detected for summarize-text canary @3612345678 -> SLA alert :warning:

Sophia: Hypothesis: fused-attn-v2 is faster for larger batches but slower on tiny batches; combined with smaller batches we see regressed p95. Quick mitigations: (A) force legacy kernel for microbatch_size<4; (B) raise token_budget for this route.

Ash: Also try increasing queue_hold_ms from 5 -> 10 to let batches form, and bump token_budget to 512.

Mina: Kicking a 3-change canary: 1) kernel=legacy if microbatch_size<4, 2) token_budget=512 for summarize-text, 3) prefetch window -> 64. Rolling to 3 nodes now, 1h run.

Raj: Long-term we should make kernel_selector cost-aware: include expected batch-size estimate and a kernel vs batch-size perf matrix.

Ash: Agree. Add a small perf harness that sweeps seq lens (512/1k/4k) and batch sizes to build deterministic perf tables per kernel.

deploy-bot: canary rollout finished on 3 nodes (build 2026.03.18-canary-29)

Mina (35m): Update: after 35m p95 on canary dropped to ~130ms. KV hit-rate recovered +4% vs earlier. avg_batch up to 3.4. Tiny batches reduced. Looks promising.

Sophia: Follow-ups: 1) Make kernel_selector use batch-size heuristic, 2) add route-tier prescriptive token_budget map (summarize-text default 512 for standard), 3) add perf gating to kernel rollouts (fail if p95 increases >10%).

Mina: Opening INF ticket + RFC for selector change and route-budget map. INF-3248: https://redwood/internal/INF-3248 :spiral_note_pad:

Ash: Once RFC lands, add canary checks to rollout pipeline and a dashboard: kernel_efficiency_by_batch_size.

Mina: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
